title: Kimball Electronics to Participate in March Investor Conferences and Host Fireside Discussions
summary: Kimball Electronics, Inc. (Nasdaq: KE) today announced its upcoming participation in multiple investor conferences in March 2026, including hosted fireside chats and one-on-one meetings with institutional investors. Cantor Global Technology Industrial Growth Conference When: Wednesday, March 11, 2026 Location: New York Hilton Midtown, 1335 Avenue of the Americas, New York, NY 10019 Format: Fireside chat (in-person participation only) and one-on-one meetings Fireside Chat: 2:10 p.m. – 2:40 p.m. ET with Cantor Analyst Derek Soderberg KeyBanc Capital Markets Healthcare Forum When: Wednesday, March 18, 2026 Location: Virtual Format: Fireside chat and one-on-one meetings Fireside Chat: 9:00 a.m. – 9:35 a.m. ET with KeyBanc Analyst Brett Fishbin Webcast: https://wsw.com/webcast/key40/ke/1386096 38th Annual Roth Conference When: Monday – Tuesday, March 23 – 24, 2026 Location: The Ritz-Carlton, Laguna Niguel, Dana Point, CA Format: One-on-one meetings only About Kimball Electronics,
